import random
import sys

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
r = random.Random(seed)
n = r.randint(1, 12)
q = r.randint(1, 20)
ops = []
for _ in range(q):
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        ops.append('1 %d %d' % (r.randint(1, n), r.randint(1, n)))
    else:
        ops.append('2 %d' % r.randint(1, n))
if not any(o.startswith('2') for o in ops):
    ops[-1] = '2 %d' % r.randint(1, n)
print(n, q)
print('\n'.join(ops))
